summary: Finance baseline for the integration benefits case, prepared at the end of 2025. Realised administrative savings from firms A-F are kept apart from commercial opportunities that have not been approved, and each site records its reporting currency, period and calculation assumptions. Commercial items are not counted as delivered until they are approved.

sheets.name: Basis
rows: Retained for each firm and translated at the monthly group rate. US firms (C and F) report in USD locally.
Final for the December 2025 integration review
Realised savings are only those evidenced in the ledger after the cost has left the firm. Opportunities stay in the second sheet until the Integration Steering Group approves them.
Local scientific operations are not reduced by this case. Savings come from shared administration only.

comments.text: The historical discounts for the firms that have not moved to the common price list are still applied in the ledger. They are not part of this baseline.
comments.author: Andrea Beckett

sheets.name: Realised
rows: Headcount in the old finance team not backfilled

Duplicate licences cancelled; no change to user count
Notice period ends in the 2026 financial year
Month-end close now run from the group ledger
Only from the date the group booking account went live

comments.text: Realised here means posted and evidenced. Anything not yet in the ledger goes on the Opportunities sheet.
comments.author: Andrea Beckett

rows: Depends on the HR and payroll consolidation
Commercial terms with suppliers still being negotiated
